name: Aeldari Warlock Perils

descriptionMarkdown:
Aeldari Warlocks use the standard Perils rules unless the GM chooses to use this specialised
table. These results should feel like rune backlash, spirit-stone shrieking, fate distortion, or
webway trauma rather than crude daemonic possession.
Severity Aeldari Peril Result
2-6 Rune Static You take 1d6 psychic damage and cannot use Rune Ward until the start of your next turn.
7-10 Ghosthelm Pain You take 2d6 psychic damage and have disadvantage on your next psychic attack roll or psychic 
saving throw before the end of your next turn.
11-14 Ancestral Echo Every creature within 10 ft hears dead voices through your mind. Each creature, including you, 
takes 1d6 psychic damage and cannot take reactions until its next turn.
15-18 Fate Snarl Until the end of your next turn, the first d20 roll made by you or an ally within 30 ft is reduced by 
1d4.
19-22 Spirit-Stone Cry You are incapacitated until the end of your next turn. One ally within 30 ft takes 1d6 psychic 
damage unless they succeed on a Wisdom save against your Psychic Save DC.
23-26 Rune Miscast The GM chooses a Warlock, Divination, or Telekinesis power you know. It immediately targets a 
random valid creature or location.
27-30 Webway Shear A 10-ft radius area within 30 ft becomes distorted terrain for 1 minute. A creature entering it for the 
first time on a turn or starting there takes 2d6 force damage.
31+ Doom of the Seer You drop to 0 hit points. Every creature within 30 ft takes 4d6 psychic damage. You gain 1 
Corruption or a GM-approved Doom Mark tied to Aeldari fate, spirit-stones, or daemonic pursuit.
